description: The separation of pkix-path (no_std, pure validation) from pkix-revocation (std, network-adjacent) is architecturally correct. The #[forbid(unsafe_code)] and no_std guard are consistently enforced. Future contributors may suggest adding alloc to pkix-path for heap-backed TBS encoding — this would break the embedded use case (Caliptra, DPE) which is a first-class user.
title: pkix-path no_std commitment is correct and well-enforced
